dependency_closure_rule: The two postimages import only each other, the eleven pinned existing files above, and existing node:crypto. Their unchanged transitive subgraphs, package manifests and lockfiles are frozen by checked_on.tree. No new package or generated file is required. Preserving these existing dependencies is part of the proposal; copying the full Operations tree is forbidden.
behavior_preserved: Sourcing, src_pending and src_rejected use sourcing monetary facts even when select_quote has already created future PO lines.
The helper computes sourcing baseAmount from a shallow projection with po:null; it does not mutate the stored request, lifecycle status, approvals or FX snapshots.
Requests/register and request list/detail consume the same monetary helper. PO-only text gets a separate read projection and labels including cancelled.
Submitted FX snapshots retain priority. A submitted EUR 100 at 1.08 remains USD 108 after live FX changes; a future USD 200 PO is displayed separately.
Missing amount, currency, quantity, unit price or applicable FX is rendered unavailable and is not manufactured as zero.
Commands, authorization, request identity, source versions, CAS, C16, Memory ownership and observations are unchanged.
Exports implementation and assertions are unchanged; session11 keeps that responsibility.

illustrative_recheck_case.expected: Current request = USD 108; separate future PO estimate = USD 200; never USD 200 as the sourcing request amount.
